Name: They Deserve It Too - Portraits for East Scarp
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod adds portraits for various interactable characters who appear in [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/i] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]Lemurkat[/url].

Part of the [i]They Deserve It Too[/i] series, aiming to give portraits to various [i]SDV[/i] characters:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414][i]Portraits for Vendors[/i][/url]: Give portraits to vanilla vendors, also comes with various extra features.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358][i]Portraits for Extras[/i][/url]: Give portraits to all extra characters, from event characters to festival attendees.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37152][i][i]Portraits for Central Station[/i][/i][/url][b][i]: [/i][/b]Give portraits to all the tourists who visit the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000][i]Central Station[/i][/url] by[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild] Pathoschild[/url][b][i].[/i][/b][/*]
[*][b][i]Portraits for East Scarp[/i][/b]: You are here![/*]
[/list][b][color=#ffe599][size=6]M[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]ods Interaction[/color][/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358][i]Portraits for Extras[/i][/url] will enable portraits for a few extra characters that need it to work.

[color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have﻿ [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] [/i]installed and working.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Portraits for East Scarp[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]TDIT - Portraits for East Scarp[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Only works with [i]SMAPI[/i] version 4.3.2 and later.[/*]
[*]No mod incompatibility that I know of. Please inform me if you find any.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make or update a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).
[spoiler]Built-in
[list]
[*][b]American English[/b] 1.0.1[/*]
[*][b]French[/b] 1.0.1 (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Deovos?gameId=1303]Deovos[/url])[/*]
[*][b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] 1.0.1[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]C[/size][size=5]redits[/size][/color][/b]
The portrait of Laila, the Joja lady, was drawn by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/257490523]HeartOfFlowers[/url].

[color=#d5a6bd][size=6][b]S[/b][/size][/color][size=5][b][color=#d5a6bd]pecial Thanks[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Lemurkat[/b], for bringing the East Scarp to life.[/*]
[*][b]mushymato, [/b]for creating the [i]PortraitsForAll[/i] framework, which makes adding portraits for various extras possible.[/*]
[/list]
